The low presence of Human Papillomavirus (HPV) DNA in pterygia does not support the hypothesis that HPV is involved in the development of pterygium in Denmark. This suggests that there may be no link between HPV infection and the development of pterygium.

In other words, there is currently insufficient evidence to confirm a causal relationship between HPV infection and the development of pterygium. Further research with larger sample sizes and more detailed analysis is needed to determine if there is a connection between these two conditions.
